title: Heat from collision
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the heat generated as Q = (2/3)mgh.

title: Maximum height on incline
description: Essential: Correctly determines the maximum height as h' = h/18.

title: Maximum velocity of C
description: Essential: Correctly states the maximum velocity of plane C as v_C = sqrt(2gh)/3.

title: Conservation of momentum (collision)
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation to find the common velocity of A and B after the inelastic collision.

title: System momentum conservation
description: Important: Applies horizontal momentum conservation to the system of (A+B) and C when they interact on the incline.

title: Energy conservation for motion
description: Important: Applies mechanical energy conservation correctly for the (A+B) and C system relative to the ground.

title: Velocity condition at max speed
description: Optional: Recognizes that C reaches its maximum speed when (A+B) have zero horizontal velocity relative to C.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for velocity components when applying momentum conservation on the incline.

title: Energy double-counting
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly includes gravitational potential energy change during the collision or sliding phase.
